newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Croatian Prime Minister to visit Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Prime Minister to visit Indonesia.

text.p: Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa will make a five-day official visit to Indonesia starting on Wednesday to strengthen bilateral ties, the official Antara news agency reported on Monday.
The agency quoted State Secretary Murdiono as saying Matesa, accompanied by three economic ministers and his wife, would also discuss international issues with President Suharto.
Murdiono said an air agreement between Indonesia and Croatia was expected to be signed during the visit.
Matesa was also scheduled to visit a factory of Indonesian aicraft maker PT Industri Pesawat Terbang Nusantara (IPTN) and the island resort of Bali.
Indonesia opened diplomatic relations with Croatia in 1992.
